At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.Principal Portfolio Strategist (all genders)Are you passionate about identifying new growth opportunities and shaping the future of Radiology? In this role, you will leverage strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and deep market insights to evaluate emerging opportunities, challenge assumptions, and support high-impact business decisions. Working across functions and leadership levels, you will help translate complex market, scientific, and business developments into actionable strategies that drive long-term value creation and strengthen Bayer’s competitive position.YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSABILITIES- You will drive the strategic assessment and prioritization of new growth opportunities in Radiology, with a particular focus on molecular imaging, by evaluating customer and patient needs, market dynamics, scientific advancements, competitive trends, reimbursement landscapes, and Bayer’s strategic fit-  You will develop opportunity theses, growth strategies, and value-creation pathways, including organic growth, partnerships, licensing opportunities, business development initiatives, and ecosystem collaborations- You will build and maintain a robust fact base on molecular imaging and adjacent growth areas, covering technologies, clinical pathways, competitors, emerging business models, and value pools to support evidence-based decision making- You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders across business, R&D, medical, commercial, regulatory, market access, product supply, finance, and business development to translate insights into actionable strategic choices- You will identify critical uncertainties, define learning agendas, and establish clear decision points to efficiently mature strategic opportunities and investments- You will support high-priority portfolio, innovation, business, and operating-model initiatives across Radiology by structuring complex challenges, developing hypotheses, and creating decision frameworks that enable effective problem solving- You will conduct and guide rigorous qualitative and quantitative analyses, including market assessments, competitor evaluations, scenario planning, capability reviews, portfolio analyses, strategic fit assessments, and risk evaluations- You will synthesize complex information into clear strategic implications, options, trade-offs, and recommendations for senior leadership and governance bodies- You will strengthen decision quality by ensuring strategic recommendations are built on robust evidence, transparent assumptions, credible alternatives, and clearly defined decision criteria- You will facilitate cross-functional discussions and strategic workshops, challenge assumptions constructively, align diverse stakeholder perspectives, and support informed decision making without exercising direct decision authority- You will build trusted relationships with senior leaders and subject matter experts, communicate complex topics to diverse audiences, and integrate external perspectives where specialized expertise is required- You will contribute to the continuous development of Bayer’s strategy capabilities by sharing methodologies, frameworks, best practices, and lessons learned across the organizationWHO YOU ARE- You have an advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, engineering, business, economics, or a related field; a combination of scientific and business expertise is highly valued- You bring substantial experience in strategy, corporate development, management consulting, business development, portfolio management, innovation, or a similar strategic role within healthcare or life sciences- You possess hands-on experience in biotech M&A activities, including due diligence, asset evaluation, company assessments, and investment decision processes- You have several years of experience in the molecular imaging industry in the areas of M&A, paired with a demonstrated ability to develop depth in new domains- You have a proven track record of leading complex strategic projects and supporting high-impact decisions in global, matrixed organizations- You apply advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, including hypothesis-driven thinking, market assessment, scenario planning, financial evaluation, and strategic decision analysis- You can integrate scientific, clinical, commercial, technological, financial, and operational perspectives into clear strategic recommendations- You excel at stakeholder management, facilitation, and executive communication, and are comfortable influencing senior leaders through expertise and credibility rather than authority- You demonstrate intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to navigate uncertainty while maintaining a strong focus on business outcomes- You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are considered an advantageWHAT WE OFFEROur benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 129.700€ and 163.800€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.- Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.Applications from employees in Germany who are affected by a workforce reduction will be prioritized.YOUR APPLICATIONThis is your opportunity to tackle the world’s biggest challenges with us: Maintaining our health, feeding growing populations and slowing the rate of climate change. jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionJoin our Experimental Science team and help shape the future of eye health innovation.Based in either Biberach (Riss) or Ingelheim am Rhein, this exciting opportunity offers you the chance to contribute as a Biomarker Leader within the Experimental Medicine Eye Health Innovation Unit. You will collaborate with a highly experienced, multidisciplinary team of Biomarker Leaders and Clinical Imaging Leads, bringing together expertise in disease pathophysiology, biochemistry, physics, mathematics, experimental and clinical ophthalmology, and drug development to advance therapies for conditions such as age-related macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy.We are seeking a passionate expert with a strong background in translational science and clinical endpoint development who can strengthen our team both as an individual contributor and as a leader within cross-functional matrix teams. If you are eager to drive scientific innovation and make a meaningful impact on patients' lives, we look forward to receiving your application. Apply today and help us transform the future of eye health.This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.This position can be filled either as Principal Scientist or Senior Principal Scientist.This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 1 - 2 days per week on site.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will be accountable for the development and implementation of end-to-end translational biomarker strategies from the preclinical to clinical early and late phases of drug development programs.- You will lead as a matrix leader biomarker- related activities from quantifying drug response on molecular pathways and imaging biomarkers and drives efforts to link these to impact on disease trajectories, functional assessments and patient benefit in relevant disease populations.- Furthermore, you will assume accountability for research collaborations focused on benefiting multiple programs in line with the project and disease area strategies.- You will be an active member of preclinical and clinical drug development teams and provides scientific and strategic input into the overall drug and clinical development plans by delivering fit for purpose biomarker strategies that drive decisions making and inform preclinical and drug development plans- Finally, you will collaborate with internal and external experts in academia, industry, service providers and device manufacturers for the assessment of biomarkers including AI approaches in experimental medicine and natural history studies for the identification and evaluation of biomarkers of disease and novel clinical trial endpoints.Additional tasks for the Senior Principal role- You will provide subject matter expertise and strategic guidance to internal and external projects and stakeholders and provide strategic input for multi-project and portfolio initiatives and disease area strategies.- In addition, you will lead end to end initiatives for the identification, validation and implementation of translational biomarkers and novel clinical endpoints to enable early drug development decision making and address the need to enable filing of novel and differentiated MoAs in our core indications.Requirements- PhD and/or MD degree with long term experience in research, industry or clinical setting, including several years of demonstrated biomarker-related work experience in the context of drug development- Proven ability to lead cross-functional matrix teams, drive strategic decision-making, and effectively prioritize activities to achieve both project objectives and team deliverables.- Strong expertise in methodological, bioanalytical, and clinical assessments within translational and clinical development with a deep understanding of biomarker applications across the drug development lifecycle. Prior experience in Ophthalmology or specific disease relevant human pathophysiology understanding are strong asset- Demonstrated capability to generate, integrate, and interpret preclinical, clinical, and translational data to support proof of biology, mechanism of action, dose selection, and patient stratification strategies- Strategic and innovative mindset with the ability to see the broader picture, translate complex scientific challenges into actionable solutions, and drive scientific and operational excellence- Collaborative and proactive team player with strong networking skills, capable of building effective partnerships across a global organization while working independently and within multidisciplinary teams- Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with full professional proficiency in EnglishAdditional requirements for the Senior Principal role- Recognized internally and externally as a subject matter expert, with a proven track record of delivering significant impact and innovation within the field- Well-connected within a strong international network of external experts, fostering strategic collaborations and knowledge exchange- Demonstrated experience in influencing and contributing to large-scale research initiatives, consortia, or cross-organizational programs- Strong leadership capabilities, with the ability to inspire teams, drive strategic priorities, and achieve ambitious objectivesAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What we offerWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more?
